description: This file defines the Tracker class used to track recently viewed items on a per-user basis in a CRM system, including methods for recording views, retrieving recent views, and managing history. It interacts with database tables like vtiger_tracker and vtiger_crmentity, and relies on external files for database access and logging.

classes.name: Tracker
classes.description: Class responsible for tracking recently viewed items, managing history, and interacting with database for a CRM system.

methods.name: Tracker
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger and database connection.

methods.name: track_view
methods.description: Records a view of a specific item by a user, updating tracking table after removing duplicate history.

methods.name: get_recently_viewed
methods.description: Retrieves the list of recently viewed items for a user, filtered optionally by module.

methods.name: delete_history
methods.description: Deletes specific history entries for a user and item.

methods.name: delete_item_history
methods.description: Deletes all history entries associated with a specific item.

methods.name: prune_history
methods.description: Removes oldest history entries exceeding the maximum allowed for a user.
